FN-5RPLM6-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 110
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Parker Moore
Commissions
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/10/2023
House Bill 110 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama
Board of Physical Therapy by a small, undetermined amount to implement the provisions of this
bill and the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact. The board's increased obligations could be
offset, wholly or partly, by an undetermined amount, from the board's ability to assess
administrative penalties and a board estimated $11,400 biennially to impose compact privilege
licensing fees upon licensees from compact states.
